rules: C v1: 3 generator families (qaoa, trotter, struct_random) x 5 device kinds (line, ring, grid, heavy_hex, random_sparse); per (family, device kind): train 12 / val 4 / test_in 2 seeds per size bin S 8-16, M 17-32, L 33-64 logical qubits, plus 12 XL (65-156) in test_in; seed ranges disjoint per split. test_ood = external sources never used in train: QUEKO (300), QUBIKOS (160, not redistributed), MQT Bench families not used in train, HamLib lattice Hamiltonians (not redistributed); unseen devices (Aspen-4, Tokyo, Rochester, Sycamore). probe = 60 small QUEKO instances with a verified zero-SWAP witness.
